These reviewed wheels are used only by the owner integration test extra on Python 3.12 or newer. They are unpublished candidates identified by exact hashes and source-input digests in owner-test-wheels.json. Each wheel carries its upstream license. Public installer source pins and historical compatibility fixtures remain separate from this local owner-test set.

The 0.16.0 Oida wheel, with Akousma 0.11.0, Akousmata 0.10.1 and AKOUO contract 0.13.1, is the circuit cohort for research v4; oida-0.16.0-source-inputs.json lists its source inputs. The 0.14.1 Oida wheel was the audit repair candidate for research v3 (owner-test-wheels-0.14.1.json). The earlier wheel and owner-test-wheels-0.13.2.json retain the historical inscription selection. Neither candidate is a registry publication or activation.
